notes.zh: 审阅注：情境“人畜共患瘟疫”三个阶段分别在进度 0–35、35–70、70–100；路线：观望并学习 / 提供援助（不可用于“禁止干涉”政策）/ 促成疾病；后两种每月进度 −1 / +1。进度 35 时（preftl.2002，一次）按路线抽阶段二事件；进度 70 时（preftl.2003）按前一事件设的国家标志分派阶段三事件；进度 100 时（preftl.2005）再按标志分派结局。
notes.en: Review note: the three stages cover progress 0–35, 35–70 and 70–100; approaches are watch & learn, provide aid (not under the non-interference policy) or promote disease (−1 / +1 monthly progress). At 35 (preftl.2002, once) the stage-2 event is drawn by approach; at 70 (preftl.2003) the stage-3 event by the country flag set before; at 100 (preftl.2005) the ending by flag.
